tickets.reservation: The words should say entry belongs near the pivot: with ext_atr20 3.66 the ticket should state that a trigger printing far above the base top is a chase (C5, R5), not a fresh buy.
The words should note H1 at 99% of the day's range and ext_atr20 3.55: the buy range is close to the pivot, and a fill far past it is a chase (C5, R5).
A WATCH ticket's words should name the pause it waits for (a tight flag near the pivot 134.99) before the trigger counts, as the VLTO and GPN tickets do.

tickets.objection: Trigger in_zone:ma_20 buys the low of the pullback itself; my method buys the turn back up or the pivot breakout, never the anticipated low (C5, C9).
tickets.would_clear: A trigger that fires on the turn up out of the ma_20 zone, e.g. h1_close_above:bar_high after price tags ma_20.
